framework_requirement_summary: Implement encryption and decryption mechanisms to protect ePHI during transmission and processing
rationale: HCG-DP-001 directly prevents ePHI from entering unauthorized telemetry destinations — the control satisfies the technical safeguard requirement by blocking transmission before it occurs rather than encrypting in transit
notes: Core HIPAA technical safeguard — encryption and decryption of ePHI

framework_requirement_summary: Implement a mechanism to encrypt ePHI in transit whenever deemed appropriate
rationale: The control prevents ePHI from reaching any transmission pathway to an unauthorized destination — satisfies the spirit and mechanism of the transmission security standard

framework_requirement_summary: The entity implements logical access security software infrastructure and architectures over protected information assets to protect them from security events
rationale: HCG-DP-001 enforces a logical boundary preventing sensitive information from reaching unauthorized processors — maps to the logical access and protection architecture requirement
notes: SOC 2 logical access and protection — illustrative mapping requiring assessor review

framework_requirement_summary: The entity restricts the transmission movement and removal of information to authorized internal and external users and processes
rationale: The control directly restricts transmission of sensitive information to unauthorized external telemetry destinations — strong alignment with CC6.7 transmission restriction requirement
notes: SOC 2 transmission restriction — illustrative mapping requiring assessor review

framework_requirement_summary: The entity monitors system components and the operation of those components for anomalies that are indicative of malicious acts natural disasters and errors affecting the entity's ability to meet its objectives
rationale: Canary-based detection and signed evidence receipts satisfy the monitoring and anomaly-detection requirement — a failed canary is a detected anomaly triggering the exception workflow
notes: SOC 2 monitoring and anomaly detection — illustrative mapping requiring assessor review

framework_requirement_summary: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems networks and any other devices that process store or transmit sensitive information
rationale: HCG-DP-001 is a data leakage prevention control at the telemetry egress point — direct alignment with A.8.12 data leakage prevention requirement
notes: ISO 27001 data leakage prevention — illustrative mapping requiring assessor review

framework_requirement_summary: Logs that record activities exceptions faults and other relevant events shall be produced retained and reviewed
rationale: The control produces signed hash-chained detection logs as evidence — local logging of detection events without external transmission satisfies the logging requirement while maintaining the boundary
notes: ISO 27001 logging — illustrative mapping requiring assessor review

framework_requirement_summary: Networks systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents
rationale: Canary-based telemetry monitoring detects anomalous boundary behavior — failed canary triggers the exception workflow satisfying the monitoring and incident evaluation requirement
notes: ISO 27001 monitoring — illustrative mapping requiring assessor review

framework_requirement_summary: The confidentiality integrity and availability of data-at-rest are protected
rationale: Preventing sensitive information from entering telemetry systems protects confidentiality at rest in downstream log stores — the control stops the data from reaching unauthorized storage entirely
notes: NIST CSF 2.0 data at rest protection

framework_requirement_summary: The confidentiality integrity and availability of data-in-transit are protected
rationale: The control intercepts sensitive information before transmission to unauthorized destinations — direct alignment with data-in-transit protection requirement
notes: NIST CSF 2.0 data in transit protection

framework_requirement_summary: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events
rationale: Canary-based telemetry monitoring continuously detects boundary failures — synthetic PHI injection on every deployment satisfies continuous monitoring of the egress pathway

framework_requirement_summary: The information system enforces approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information within the system and between interconnected systems
rationale: The control enforces an information flow boundary at the telemetry egress point — only non-sensitive telemetry is authorized to flow to external destinations

framework_requirement_summary: The information system generates audit records containing information that establishes what type of event occurred when the event occurred where the event occurred the source of the event the outcome of the event and the identity of any individuals or subjects associated with the event
rationale: Hash-chained evidence receipts produced by the detector satisfy the audit record content requirement — each receipt records event type timestamp source outcome and detector version

framework_requirement_summary: The organization manages and retains information within the information system and information output from the system in accordance with applicable federal laws executive orders directives policies regulations standards and operational requirements
rationale: The control prevents sensitive information from being retained in unauthorized external log systems — local retention of detection evidence satisfies the information management and retention requirement
notes: NIST 800-53 Rev 5 information management and retention
